items.title: Home Core Kit
items.pricing_status: APPROVED Nov 12, 2026 — Lane 2 BOM basis governs ($706.82 x2 = $1,413.64). DB-basket $2,205.24 NOT adopted (Kent's ruling, Nov 12).
items.short_description: Whole-home diagnostic and smart monitoring core kit across HVAC, electrical loads, water points, and air quality.
items.long_description: The Building OBD Home Core Kit provides whole-building diagnostic telemetry across plug/load-level electrical, plumbing water points, HVAC performance, and environmental air quality. Includes listen-only life-safety acoustic/sensor integration (never replaces listed smoke/CO alarms; never sold as a fire or burglar alarm). Priced at 2x verified Lane 2 hardware BOM ($706.82). Installation available via contract field techs or self-guided baseline walk.
